quotes.text: Your feelings are valid, and it's okay to not be okay sometimes.

quotes.text: Healing is not linear. It's okay to take one step forward and two steps back.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: You are stronger than you think, and braver than you believe.

quotes.text: It's okay to take a break. Rest is not a sign of weakness, but of wisdom.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Your mental health is a priority. Your happiness is essential. Your self-care is a necessity.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: You don't have to be perfect to be worthy of love and respect.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Every day is a fresh start. Every moment is a new beginning.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Your feelings are temporary visitors. Let them come, and let them go.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Small steps forward are still progress. Celebrate every victory, no matter how small.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: You are not alone in your struggles. Reach out, and let others in.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Your mind is a garden. Nurture it with positive thoughts and watch it bloom.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: It's okay to ask for help. It's a sign of strength, not weakness.

quotes.text: You are enough, just as you are. No conditions, no exceptions.

quotes.text: Your journey is unique. Don't compare it to anyone else's path.
